purpose: Resolve the remaining generic subgroup-family gaps only where a Nigerian occupational label is confirmed by NBS and the selected domain has a separate Nigerian professional, occupational-standard, training or sector source supporting the displayed preparation.

policy.label_evidence: NBS confirms that the generic ISCO family vocabulary is used in Nigerian labour classification; NBS alone does not establish skills, tools or credentials.
policy.item_evidence: Skills, tools, competencies and certification routes are attached only from the named domain-relevant Nigerian sources.
policy.scope: These are domain-scoped family overlays, not claims that every occupation in an ISCO family has the same preparation or that a credential is universally required.
